# Version 4.150.0
> **Skia m150 stable release** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 delivers the Skia m150 engine update with new rendering APIs and runtime improvements. It adds culling, image-filter, and overdraw APIs, improves canvas wrapper performance, fixes raster blur behavior, and updates HarfBuzz.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Updated to Skia m150** — Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 150 and includes the matching upstream stability fixes. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146), [#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))

## API Surface

- **New culling, overdraw, and image-filter APIs** — Adds SKPaint.GetFastBounds, SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw, and crop and empty SKImageFilter factories. ([#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271), [#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227), [#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229), [#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228))

## Bug Fixes

- **Small-sigma raster blurs render correctly** — Avoids a slow raster blur pipeline regression that could affect the appearance and performance of small blur radii. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKSurface reuses its canvas wrapper** — Repeated Canvas access avoids unnecessary wrapper allocation while preserving the same managed canvas instance. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Updates the bundled HarfBuzzSharp native stack to 14.2.1.
